limitations: Bounded synthetic v2 bridge only; no real corpus, rights approval, production ingestion, tokenizer or Mini model.
One smoke configuration and one seed; no convergence, quality, production throughput or checkpoint-service claim.
Atomic local checkpoint replacement; no fsync/power-loss guarantee. At most interval-1 completed updates can be lost after the last durable checkpoint under normal single-writer interruption.
Test blocks are verified by the loader but are not used for training or evaluation.
Checkpoint write and validation times are descriptive only; no timing threshold or speed claim.
